offering_description.value: Sterling prepares sites and installs electrical and mechanical systems for data centers, semiconductor plants, and other large facilities. It also builds and reconstructs transportation infrastructure for public agencies and pours concrete foundations and slabs for homebuilders and commercial contractors.

primary_services.value: site development and excavation; electrical and mechanical contracting; highway and bridge construction; airport and rail construction; concrete foundation and slab construction

customer_segment.value: B2B: Data center operators, advanced manufacturers, distribution facility developers, general contractors, and homebuilders; B2G: State transportation departments, municipal public works agencies, and airport authorities

end_markets.value: data centers; advanced manufacturing; logistics and distribution; transportation infrastructure; residential and commercial construction

revenue_model.value: project or contract: Owners and general contractors pay for defined construction scopes under competitively bid or negotiated contracts

value_chain_position.value: service provider: Uses construction crews, equipment, and purchased materials to build infrastructure for owners, public agencies, and general contractors

geography_served.value: US national: Projects across the United States, with transportation and building operations concentrated in selected regions

specialization.value: related lines: Site development, electrical and mechanical systems, transportation construction, and concrete foundations

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Negotiated contracts and competitive bids with facility owners, general contractors, homebuilders, and public agencies

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: Construction is subject to OSHA standards, environmental and stormwater permits, building codes, and public works procurement rules.
